sections.title: Secure gate access for your club
sections.subtitle: Scan a QR code to check in and out, always know who is on the property, and keep gate combinations safe.

items.title: QR check-in
items.text: Members and permit holders check in and out at the gate in seconds.

items.title: Monthly combinations
items.text: Gate combinations rotate monthly and are only shown to authorised people.

items.title: Live occupancy
items.text: See who is on the property right now, and who is overdue to leave.

items.title: Role-based access
items.text: Administrators, gate controllers, members and permit holders each see what they need.

items.title: Register
items.text: Create your account and get your personal QR code.

items.title: Scan at the gate
items.text: Check in on arrival and check out when you leave.

items.title: Stay informed
items.text: Controllers and administrators get occupancy and history reports.

sections.title: Ready to get started?
sections.text: Log in or create an account to continue.
